name: Budget grain
description: Budget calculations are grouped at the daycare and month level.
reason: This is the shared business grain used for budget planning, payroll comparison, and dashboard summaries.

name: Payroll grain
description: Payroll rows are aggregated by daycare and month before comparison with budget data.
reason: The payroll API must merge cleanly with budget groups without relying on current sheet row order.

name: Daycare-month merge key
description: Keyed API objects use daycare and month joined with a pipe character.
reason: This gives future comparison code a stable lookup key while keeping array responses available for display.

name: Average employee monthly hours
description: Default monthly hours used to translate required classroom hours into required employee headcount.
reason: Regulatory staff and real employee headcount are separate planning numbers.
editability: Configurable later; fixed in UI now

name: requiredStaff
description: Represents staffing required by child counts and classroom ratios.
reason: This must remain distinct from actual employee count for compliance and planning.

name: requiredEmployeeHeadcount
description: Represents real-world employee count derived from required hours and average monthly hours.
reason: Managers need operational headcount, not only regulatory staffing ratios.

name: Budget can be partial
description: Missing budget categories should not block available budget calculations.
reason: The system must remain useful while sheets are incomplete or being prepared.

name: Dynamic spreadsheet data
description: Daycares, months, employees, classes, categories, costs, hours, and row counts are treated as data.
reason: Adding or removing sheet rows must not require code changes.

name: Current Google Sheets values
description: Current sheet values validate parsing, grouping, calculations, and API structure only.
reason: Business logic must not be inferred from temporary or sample values.

name: Unknown or incomplete values
value: ignore safely and report when needed
description: Unknown, missing, incomplete, or unmapped values should not crash the application.
reason: Operational sheets are edited by people and may be temporarily incomplete.

name: Payroll empty rows
description: Blank payroll rows are skipped during parsing.
reason: Sheets commonly contain spacing rows or unfinished areas.

name: Payroll rows missing daycare or month
description: Rows without daycare or month do not enter daycare-month aggregates.
reason: The merge grain requires both fields; partial rows should not corrupt totals.

name: Payroll cost detection
description: Payroll cost totals use numeric fields whose headers indicate cost, salary, pay, amount, reimbursement, deduction, or equivalent Hebrew terms.
reason: The parser must stay data-driven without hardcoding employee names, classes, or current sheet rows.

name: Payroll hours detection
description: Payroll hour totals use numeric fields whose headers indicate hours or equivalent Hebrew terms.
reason: Hours must remain separate from payroll cost for comparison and dashboard analysis.

name: Payroll byClass
description: Payroll groups expose class-level summaries for cost, hours, rows, and employee count.
reason: Managers need class-level visibility without changing the daycare-month merge contract.

name: Transaction categories
value: תקציבי; תקציב חריג; חריג לא לחישוב
description: Known transaction classification labels used for budget and bank-data interpretation.
reason: Financial categorization affects budget coverage and exception reporting.
editability: Editable later with controlled admin UI

name: Internal rules page
description: Rules are displayed from a local rules data file and cannot be edited in the UI.
reason: Administrators and developers need visibility now; editing requires validation and permissions later.
